Title: Truth of Blood / Show of force with SUP form of mist

Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
If I play an action like Truth of Blood or Show of Force, do I trigger the block effect every time I block the action if it continues with cards like Form of Mist at superior?

Combat
Form of Mist
Protean Strike: dodge.
Superior Protean Strike: combat ends. After combat ends, if this vampire was blocked while performing an action, they can burn 1 blood to continue the action with +1 stealth as if unblocked, even if stealth is not yet needed. A vampire can play only one Form of Mist at superior each action.

Action
Truth of Blood
AuspexQuietus Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed. If this action is blocked, the blocking minion's controller discards 2 cards at random before block resolution. Those cards are not replaced until after this action.
Superior AuspexSuperior Quietus As above, but bleed with +2 bleed.

Action
Show of Force
Potence Presence Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed. If this action is blocked, before range is determined during the first round of the resulting combat, this vampire can gain +1 strength that combat.
Superior Potence Superior Presence As above, but at +2 bleed and this vampire can gain +2 strength.

thanks!

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish
